1
 In The Supreme Court Of India
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Criminal Appeal No. Of 2025
 (@ Slp(Crl.) No.13604/2025)
 Xyz 
 Versus
 State Of Rajasthan & Anr. 
 O R D E R

1. Leave granted.
2. We have heard the learned counsel appearing for the appellant and the learned Senior counsel and the learned counsel appearing for the respondents.
3.

The present appeal has been filed by the prosecutrix, aggrieved by the impugned order of the High Court by which the respondent No.2 has been granted bail for the offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(f), 376(2)(n) and 323 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 3 and 4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
4. Taking into consideration the facts of the case, particularly the fact that the trial has already commenced, we are inclined to direct the Registrar of the concerned High Court to make sure that the trial is completed either by transferring the case to some other Officer or by appointing an Officer in the Trial Court where the case is pending as it is submitted that the Presiding Officer of the Trial Court is not available as of now.
5.
Accordingly, we direct the trial to be completed within a period of six months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

6. Taking into consideration the subsequent FIR filed against respondent No.2, the condition imposed at the time of granting bail stands modified to the effect that the respondent No.2 shall not reside in the village in which he is residing now and also shall not enter the said village, till the conclusion of the trial.
